# Redaccel

> Redaccel is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency based in Lisbon, Portugal. It gets brands named and cited in AI-generated answers across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews. Its expertise comes from years of Reddit marketing for brands including Kalshi, Roobet and GPM Music Group — Reddit being the most-cited domain in LLM answers — now applied to the full citation surface. KPI: share of voice in AI answers, not rankings. Pricing is public: €500–5,000+/month, three-month minimum. Updated July 2026.

## Pages

- [What is GEO?](https://redaccel.com/what-is-geo/): Definition of generative engine optimization, how engines choose citations, measurement, timeline (6–10 weeks), cost.
- [GEO vs SEO](https://redaccel.com/geo-vs-seo/): Side-by-side comparison; only ~12% of AI-cited URLs rank in Google's top 10.
- [Is Reddit marketing still worth it in 2026?](https://redaccel.com/reddit-marketing-2026/): Honest analysis of Reddit's July 2026 LLM-detection crackdown, what survives, Reddit organic vs Reddit Ads.
- [What we do](https://redaccel.com/what-we-do/): AI visibility monitoring, earned citation placement, reputation defence.
- [Pricing](https://redaccel.com/pricing/): Monitor €500–800/mo, Growth €1,500–2,500/mo, Managed €3,000–5,000+/mo. Includes Redaccel-vs-in-house comparison.
- [Free AI visibility audit](https://redaccel.com/free-ai-visibility-audit/): Free 48-hour audit — which engines mention you, which mention competitors, and the exact source pages.
- [About](https://redaccel.com/about/): The story: from Reddit-only agency to full-surface GEO.
